steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Huff...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It didn't go so well with Mr. Czerny, but everyone else in the Afterglow has been nice and easy to talk with.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I've visited ten or so houses by now, and picked up a few blood samples. Not bad results.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's almost night now...

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Junge Frau, I've seen you busy all day long, running to and fro. I bet you're hungry, aren't you?

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: How about trying some Afterglow specialties?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Specialties?

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Take a look at this. Pan-fried sauerkraut! The aroma, the color!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (A pickled food sautéed in oil. The very opposite of healthy.)

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: What, scared I'm overcharging you? Here, this one's yours, free of charge!

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Don't be shy, now, you've been all over the streets checking up on us. This is to thank you.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Oh, I can't turn down hospitality...)

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Thank you very much, then.

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Don't mention it!

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: What's wrong? You've only taken one bite. I told you, it's on the house.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm not quite hungry—I'll carry on eating later.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Actually, have you ever considered adjusting your recipe slightly?

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: In what way?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You see, this serving is approximately that of an adult's, but the salt and fat content are at least three and five times the recommended intake respectively. It's more harmful than anything.

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Junge Frau, I've been making this for decades. There's no one buying it who doesn't like it.

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: If I suddenly changed my recipe, my regulars would have my head!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm suggesting it with their health in mind.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Everyone spending their money here, myself included, is an Infected. A diet so high in salt and fat can only have even worse repercussions on Infected than on the healthy...

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: I'll just ask you this one thing—does my food taste good or not?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's extremely delicious.

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Then that settles it!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But I still think—

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Alright, alright. I know you can't appreciate my craft, I get it. My heart goes out to you.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh, by the way, I'd like to ask a few questions. Can I?

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Seeing as business isn't exactly booming right now, ask away.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Well, why don't you tell me how business has been lately?

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Up to my ears! More and more people out to eat the past few days, probably thanks to the warm weather.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Are you familiar with everyone who comes to eat?

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: I am. Every patron of mine's from the Afterglow. I know basically all of them.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Are they all Infected?

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: They are.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Have there been any who hadn't shown themselves for a while, but came to buy from you again these past few days?

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: That's right. Quite a few too, if I think about it.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Could I ask you to tell me which of your customers that applies to? Where do they all live?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: No problem!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Finally... how have you been feeling recently?

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: You mean the Oripathy? Fairly regular, nothing one way or the other. But with business good lately, I've been really on top of keeping my stocks up.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm guessing you're not too obsessed with music?

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Heh, I've never been much of an artist. Don't have as much drive as them. If I can keep my family fed, I'm happy.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That's all my questioning, then.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Thank you for humoring me! I hope business thrives for you!

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Thank you, thank you.

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: But you've still only taken one bite, Junge Frau. Won't you have a little more?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Well—didn't I just—

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: I'm joking.

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: You doctors put health first, I understand that! But naturally, taste's a priority for us chefs, and doctors by and large, well, they give us some understanding back. What do you say?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Erm... I can understand, but I still can't approve.

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Just understanding's a good start. We can put our differences aside. Next time you want a bite, remember, come by!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mmhm, mmhm.

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: She has me wondering, though. Seemed on the verge of tears after she took one bite...

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: *sigh* Such a nice young girl. Makes you wonder why she had to be a Sarkaz.

steps.name: Coffee Shop Owner
steps.text: Chefkoch, one thing of sauerkraut, please.

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Coming up—oh, it's you.

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Two portions of minced meat and a slight char on your sauerkraut, yeah?

steps.name: Coffee Shop Owner
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.name: Coffee Shop Owner
steps.text: That girl just now looked a little strange. You seen her before?

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: She's been all around the streets lately. If I didn't before, I have now. What, are you going to invite her to yours for a cup?

steps.name: Coffee Shop Owner
steps.text: Forget it.

steps.name: Coffee Shop Owner
steps.text: You've seen how she's so busy. Probably on some serious business, no chance to have a coffee.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Cases with abnormal improvement are distributed over an even wider area than I guessed...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm sorry!
That's alright, I should be the one apologizing. I was so preoccupied, admiring this magnificent building, I got in the way of your motif.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...Motif?
Goodbye.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Good——

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: bye...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (She's in a hurry...)

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Though I suppose it's about time to head back. There's no residents in the square...)

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Hey, fräulein!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Um?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (What a strong smell of alcohol...)

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Yeah, you, devil!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: And you are...?

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: You just left my house! You don't remember?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: So, you're a relative of Mr. Schneider's? You didn't seem to be at home when I made my visit just now.

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: I'm his son! You sucked my father's blood!

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Hibiscus! Hibiscus!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Andante, not a moment too late. This man here's extremely worked up, and I don't know what he's trying to convey...

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Andante? Andante from Rhodes Island! Go tell your boss right now, to send this devil back home, never let her back in the Afterglow!

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: That... Just calm down for now. Tell me what she did. It helps me write my report afterward.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: (Whisper) I was wondering why you were taking so long to return... head back to the branch office for now!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Whisper) I'll observe a little longer. Something's not right here. Maybe what he says can help us out somehow.

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: She sucked my father's blood! Devil! Bloodsucker! You know what that means?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Er, Mr. Schneider, you may have heard legends about Vampires, but I'm just an ordinary Sarkaz. Fresh blood has no attractive force on me...

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Who said anything about Vampires?

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Hey, buddy. What do you say? What's she doing... collecting blood from Infected?

steps.name: Passerby Infected
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Yeah, you! G—Go on!

steps.name: Passerby Infected
steps.text: I... I'm busy right now, excuse me...

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Gah, some people got no spine...

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Bro, you—you tell me!

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Well... I'm not too sure of the details, but I have heard about Casters using Infected blood to do their Arts.

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: And the Spire Casters secretly abducting Infected lately. They're doing about the same thing...

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: That's what I want to hear! This devil's been collecting our blood from all over! That shit's exactly what she's doing!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Collecting the blood of Infected for Arts... Based on what I know, nothing apart from the, um, quote-unquote 'Witch King's remains'...
Hibiscus's mindless utterance stuns not just the two Infected into silence, but the entire crowd about them who gathered to see what the fuss was about.

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: You'd... utter the Majesty's name just like that... You really are... all tied up.

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: That's it, she has to be! It's what the prophecy said! This devil's going to use Infected blood to blast us all with Arts!

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Prophecy? You mean the one His Majesty issued...

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Right! That one! We can't let that prophecy come true!

steps.name: Meddlesome Infected
steps.text: Did you say prophecy?

steps.name: Meddlesome Infected
steps.text: I heard there was a prophecy recently, but it was all vague... what did it say, exactly?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm just as curious. You're trying to drive me off based on some prophecy, but I don't even know anything about it. How do you expect me to go, just like that?

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: We can't just talk about it out loud. Who can guarantee he didn't leave behind some kind of Arts? Maybe our each and every move is all...

steps.name: Meddlesome Infected
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Meddlesome Infected
steps.text: Th-Th-Th... Then tell us quietly. What exactly did the prophecy say?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Whisper) Andante, have you heard similar rumors recently?

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: (Whisper) It rings a faint bell, to be honest, but I never paid any attention to it...

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: (Whisper) Not to mention His Majesty died long ago. And even if he were alive and well, he'd have no reason to leave any prophecies specifically in the Afterglow.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: (Whisper) People just keep coming...

steps.name: Meddlesome Infected
steps.text: Girlie, I think you should take a hike. There's everything to fear here...

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Get out of the Afterglow!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Please, everyone, don't just trust an unfounded rumor like this!

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Rumor?! You have the gall to call a prophecy a 'rumor,' you...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sir, one moment you saying me and the Wi... those remains are 'all tied up,' the next you're suggesting I'm disrespecting him. What exactly are you trying to get at with all these contradictions? What are you inciting?

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: The way your sort behave, common sense never applies.

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Besides, who knows what a devil like you is up to, coming here to the Afterglow and using your 'investigation' as a cover to steal our blood.

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Even if you *mean* no harm, we can't just ignore the prophecy and let you stay here! Isn't that right, everyone?

steps.name: Onlooking Infected
steps.text: Yeah! That's right!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm not sure why you all seem so scared of a fictional calamity taking place here. It's probably 'His Majesty's' name hanging over you?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But there's something that scares me more.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm scared I won't be able to find an explanation for this incident.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If I cower now, then maybe I'd be losing a golden chance to save lives; maybe, I'd leave you all to be endangered just because of my own cowardice.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You can look at me like a cruel caster using Infected blood for Arts, you can treat me like some 'devil' spreading disaster... I don't mind any of it.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I just want to save lives. Beyond that, I'm not asking the Afterglow for anything else.

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: No more lies! If you don't go, you're here to destroy the Afterglow!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Everybody, I don't intend to start a conflict with you here.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If you truly want me out of sight, I can return to the Rhodes Island branch office for a time, and you can all cool down in the meanwhile. Would that be okay?

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Pssh, now you're talking reason—

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Where do you think the Rhodes office is? It's here in the Afterglow too!

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Or do you think Rhodes Island has some special privilege, huh? That you can just take it out of the Afterglow's hands?

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: We won't let that happen!

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Everyone with me! Drive this devil away!
Some come charging in, some stay motionless where they are, and some choose to turn their backs on Hibiscus, leaving this site of trouble.
No matter the choice they've made, Hibiscus simply stands there, not choosing to fight, nor choosing to flee.
